data.completion_memo: Implemented the trusted-core ProjectCoordinator over canonical local JSON repositories with workspace identity revalidation and optimistic document saves, plus a typed receipt-oriented DesktopApi with ordered committed-event snapshots. cargo test -p aworkit-trusted-core passes.
data.description: Implement project/workspace/configuration coordination over the canonical repositories and the sole versioned Tauri command/query/event boundary. Revalidate selected workspace identities, use optimistic versions, return transport receipts separately from domain completion, and stream snapshots plus ordered committed events.
data.title: M04.1 — Implement project coordination and the typed desktop API
